thread:
Alex C: Heads up — Tidecrest wants a final checklist before we flip their private deployment to live next week. Two asks: ensure KMS CMEK cross-account decrypt is locked down and confirm audit log delivery to their secure S3 bucket + Splunk. Any blockers?
Sam N: I reviewed their network design. Private subnets NAT via a single pooled NAT GW in us-west-2b. Recommend multi-AZ NAT or egress proxy for HA. Also need their EIP list for allowlisting on third-party vendors.
Mira S: On KMS: they want cross-account decrypt for our service account only. We'll need a key policy with a Condition that limits kms:Decrypt to the specific principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/tidecrest-infer and SourceAccount. I'll draft and share. Also check their key rotation cadence — they requested monthly rotation which we should caution is aggressive.
Jordan P: For audit logs: confirm CloudTrail is configured with S3 bucket ARN arn:aws:s3:::tidecrest-audit-logs and bucket policy that allows CloudTrail delivery and our account to read manifests. If they want Splunk HEC, we can forward via Kinesis Firehose with SSE-KMS; need KMS permissions for the Firehose role.
Alex C: They're asking about presigned URLs for temporary upload of model artifacts to their private S3. Is that compatible with our deployment flow?
Sam N: Presigned uploads are fine but we must ensure kms:Encrypt on upload path if they require server-side encryption. Recommend presigned POST with x-amz-server-side-encryption header.
Mira S: Also: if Firehose uses SSE-KMS, include a key policy statement that allows firehose.amazonaws.com to use the key for Encrypt/Decrypt when origin is their account. Example snippet I'll paste into the doc.
Jordan P: I'll run these validation steps tomorrow: 1) verify assume-role + kms:GenerateDataKey call from a test instance, 2) simulate CloudTrail delivery to their S3, 3) test Firehose -> Splunk delivery with test payload.
ops-team: Ops note — we need the NAT EIPs by EOD to request vendor allowlist. If they can't provide per-AZ EIPs, we recommend assigning Elastic IPs to NAT GWs in each AZ.
Alex C: Risk note for CS: their procurement renewal is due in 45 days and security signed off is requested for renewal approval. If we can't demonstrate log forwarding + KMS boundaries by end of week, escalate to AE.
Mira S: Agreed, I'll include a short compliance summary for the renewal packet: KMS key policy, CloudTrail retention (90 days hot, 365 days cold), and Splunk ingestion proof-of-delivery.
Jordan P: infra-bot created ticket CS-4938 for "Tidecrest KMS+egress validation — renewal readiness" and assigned to Jordan P. ETA: tomorrow 11:00 PT. https://redwood.example/tickets/CS-4938
Alex C: Thanks all. I'll update the customer with our timeline and request EIPs + service account ARNs in the shared folder: https://redwood.example/s/tidecrest/onboard. Quick sync at 10:30am tomorrow if needed. :calendar:
